name: Chijoku Tsuma Natsuki ~Buchou ni Hazukashimerareta Kairaku no Hibi~
original_name: 恥辱妻・奈都希～部長に辱められた快楽の日々～
source:
Natsuki has been successful and happy in both her social and private life.
Until the day where her superior makes an offer of granting the authorization to her project
if she obeys his order of any kind for one week.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE053128.html]DLsite English[/url]]
